rule: Typed receivers (decision A, all statically typed languages and typed PHP/Groovy declarations): a receiver whose type is given by a declaration — local, parameter, field/property (including `$var->prop` / `obj.field` chains whose property has a declared type), catch parameter, for-loop variable, pattern binding — or by `= new T(...)` gives `T#m` (high if defined in the scan, else medium). | **Body-less member declarations of scanned types are defined in the scan (high)**
notes: Parameter types (Repo, Greeter, Clock), typed properties (`private Repo $repo`, nullable `?Repo` names Repo, constructor-promoted `private Greeter $greeter`), `$local = new Repo()` and the catch parameter `\RuntimeException $e` all type their receiver (decision A). Greeter#greet is a body-less interface method of a scanned type → high (Decision 2026-11-09). Vendor\Clock and \RuntimeException are not scanned → medium; global-namespace class has no qualifier. The promoted-property constructor is App.Svc#<init>. `= null` is not a call. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (instance and static member calls) and direct for free functions, bare names and named nested functions.
